description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

Once upon a time, in the second half of the 20th century, the world's most popular assault rifle was the AK-47 – also commonly known as the Kalashnikov, in honor of its inventor. Today, these rifles can only be found in museums as their market niche was replaced by the Nokota Copperhead. This mass-produced assault rifle sticks to the basics of functionality and reliability. There's no finesse or ingenuity to fall in love with, but many people find its dependable stopping power endearing.

Cost: Half (Round Up) the original weapon’s Cost ♦ Availability: Price Category is unchanged

“We live in dangerous times. Violence is rampant, so everyone needs a way to defend themselves. Sadly, many can’t afford effective problem-solvers, which is where bootlegs come to save the day. Yeah, customizing ‘em is a pain and they fall apart easier, but look at that price tag!”

An Ironfake Variant Weapon becomes Exotic if it was not already so, is reduced to Poor Quality, and all of its BODY requirements (if any) are increased by 1 (e.g., BODY 10+ to not jam is now BODY 11+ to not jam). If the weapon was already Poor Quality, its Ironfake Variant now jams when rolling any 1 during the Attack Check (i.e., not negated by Fumble Recovery) and when it malfunctions, it requires an additional Action to clear the malfunction. An Ironfake Weapon cannot be bought using the CEMK’s rule of purchasing it at double its Cost to source it without a Fixer.

Exotic Poor Quality Heavy Pistol. Holds 12 rounds. When making an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6).

Simple Leather armor for your head. No armor penalty.

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2

Cost: 100eb (Premium) ♦ Install: Mall

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

Originally intended for special operations use, this quickly-abandoned implant enables projecting a one-way holographic mask over the user’s face, entirely obscuring it while still providing full vision.

External Body Cyberware. While active, this cyberware masks the user's face from external sources, including cameras. Anyone attempting a Human Perception or Lip Reading check against users with this cyberware active takes a -2 penalty to their check. Counts as an instance of Gang Colors Jewelry for Scavengers, if tweaked to the right display setting. Turning this cyberware on or off takes an Action. NOTE: This is the digital facemask that Scavs use in 2077. The World of 2077 book specifically mentions “K.E.R.S” for the Scavengers, so that’s what this was inspired by.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Mall
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • The -2 applies to other people's checks, so it can't be automated from this item.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
